description: A limit on how often one mobile number may be contacted by automation.

fields.label: Limit Contacts Per Number
fields.description: When on, each workflow WhatsApp send or call checks the count first. When off, nothing counts or fails.

fields.label: Limit
fields.description: A send the provider refuses gives its slot back.

fields.label: Most Contacts
fields.description: Workflow sends allowed to one number in the period, from 1 to 20. WhatsApp and calls count together.

fields.label: Period Length
fields.description: How far back the count reaches from now. The window rolls, so it does not reset when a new month starts.

fields.label: Period Unit
fields.description: The unit for the period length. The count treats a week as 7 days and a month as 30 days.

name: CRM Contact Cap Settings
